description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink Open Source Test Management tool. It handles exporting test plan data in different formats (XML), including complete plans, results, and linked items, based on user-supplied parameters. It initializes necessary components, processes user requests, and generates downloadable XML files.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for export options including export type, filenames, and filters.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI parameters like filenames, page titles, and context info based on the test plan and provided arguments.
